direct_file_reviews.summary: The prompt requires a pure Rust 2021 port of test12.cpp, identical CLI argument handling, byte-for-byte output, no external crates, a complete Cargo project in /output, and test12.rs at package root.
Parallel cell metadata reports actual parallel use, five subagents, process and protocol success, artifact_ok true, and a completed 40/40 quality result.
Parallel status records the official completed RepoZero C2Rust evaluation with solution_passed true, 40 evaluated testcases, 40 passed, and pass_rate 1.0.
Parallel evaluation summary mirrors the official result: completed true, ok true, 40/40 passed, and solution_passed true.

timeline_reviews.summary: Transport-only server journal for the parallel session; it records session creation, tool transport, subagent completion transport, and prompt completion, with no semantic events projected.
Parallel session index maps the single Kimi session to the workspace session directory and confirms the work directory as /workspace.

Implementation child received the porting task, created Cargo.toml, test12.rs, and inflection modules, fixed an import error, corrected singularize/classify behavior after binary probing, built with rustc and cargo, and reported successful differential checks.
Read-only verifier child tested pluralize and singularize at argument position 1 against the C++ binary, adapted from missing python3 to awk, and reported 2741 passing comparisons with no mismatches.
Read-only verifier child tested camelize and underscore at argument position 2, generated targeted and random inputs with perl after python3 was unavailable, and reported 3118 passing comparisons.
Read-only verifier child tested classify and tableize at argument position 3, reran byte-exact cmp checks including the release binary, and reported 2378 passing cases.
Read-only verifier child tested humanize, dasherize, upcase, and downcase at argument position 4, used perl-generated inputs, checked 0-arg and 6-arg cases, and reported 2390 passing cases.

Parallel parent probed the reference binary, formed an initial behavioral spec, delegated the whole implementation to one coder, consumed the returned implementation summary, launched a four-child verification swarm, consumed all verifier returns, and finalized after all reported zero mismatches.

direct_file_reviews.summary: The serial prompt is byte-identical to the parallel prompt and requires the same pure Rust Cargo project, test12.rs deliverable, standard-library-only implementation, and black-box behavior matching.
Serial cell metadata reports no parallel uptake, zero subagents, artifact_ok true, process and protocol success, and a completed 40/40 quality result.
Serial status records the official completed RepoZero C2Rust evaluation with solution_passed true, 40 evaluated testcases, 40 passed, and pass_rate 1.0.
Serial evaluation summary mirrors the official result: completed true, ok true, 40/40 passed, and solution_passed true.

timeline_reviews.summary: Transport-only server journal for the serial session; it records the single main-agent turn lifecycle and prompt completion, with no semantic events projected.
Serial session index maps the Kimi session to the workspace session directory and confirms the work directory as /workspace.

Serial main agent independently probed the reference binary, wrote the Cargo project and modules, fixed the initially incomplete singularization and uncountable handling, rebuilt, fuzzed thousands of cases, verified rustc and cargo binaries, and finalized successfully.

parallel.requirements: The parallel run recognized the need for a standard-library Rust port of the four-position CLI behavior, with test12.rs at /output and byte-identical output against /workspace/dataset/test12_executable.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent first probed behavior, then assigned the entire implementation to one coder child and later assigned four read-only verifier children by API group; no component implementation was split across incompatible owners.
parallel.implementation: The implementation child created Cargo.toml, test12.rs, inflection/case.rs, inflection/plural.rs, and inflection/mod.rs, corrected an import error, then replaced the naive plural/singular logic with a rule set matching binary probes.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The child wrote the final project directly in /output, including the required root entry file and a release build; the parent accepted that integrated tree after reviewing the child report and verifier results.
parallel.verification: The child ran rustc and cargo builds, documented example diffs, curated cases, fuzzing, UTF-8 checks, and the parent verification swarm independently exercised all four API groups with thousands of byte-exact comparisons.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No unfinished task work is evident at closure: the parent final report states all verification passed, the artifact contains the expected files, and the official evaluator reports 40/40 passed.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same pure Rust, no-dependency, std::env::args, byte-for-byte output, Cargo project, and /output/test12.rs requirements from the prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The single main agent owned probing, implementation, correction, build, fuzzing, and final delivery without subagents or handoff boundaries.
serial.implementation: The serial agent wrote Cargo.toml, test12.rs, inflection/mod.rs, inflection/case.rs, and inflection/singular.rs, then fixed its placeholder and uncountable-list mistakes before closure.
serial.integration_and_delivery: All code and binaries were assembled locally in /output, with test12.rs present at the package root and cargo/rustc outputs verified before the final response.
serial.verification: The serial agent ran documented examples, 161 curated edge cases, 3637 synthetic/random words, 200 random four-argument combinations, and build checks, all matching the C++ reference.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No unfinished task work is evident at closure: the final response reports byte-identical verification and the official evaluator records 40/40 passed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the Rust 2021, std-only, std::env::args, Cargo layout, /output/test12.rs, and byte-for-byte reference-matching obligations.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same prompt obligations and worked from the same reference executable and examples.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-coverage difference; both ultimately targeted all CLI positions and the black-box binary behavior.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent kept initial probing, delegated the whole implementation to one coder child, then split verification across four read-only children by function group.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial main agent retained all probing, implementation, correction, verification, and delivery ownership locally.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel workflow introduced child boundaries for implementation and verification, but the implementation had a single owner and the verification work was read-only and independent.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The implementation child received a whole-port assignment and enough testing direction to discover that the parent's initial singularize/classify model was wrong, then returned a detailed implementation and verification handoff.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial carried all discovered behavioral rules in one context, including the later uncountable-list correction and fuzz strategy.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had more handoff boundaries, but they did not lose required context: the child corrected the behavioral rules and the parent consumed the return before verification.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel implementation used separate case and plural modules, rewrote plural.rs after probing, and made classify call singularize before camelize.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implementation used case and singular modules under an Inflector facade, fixed placeholder singularization, and added the uncountable list.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The file organization differs, but both implementations converged on the asymmetric reference behavior and the required CLI output.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent retrieved the implementation child result, then retrieved the verification swarm aggregate before finalizing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle and finalized from its own local build and test evidence.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel added successful result joins; no completed child result was trapped, ignored, or merged late.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Only the implementation child wrote the project files in /output; later verifier children were instructed not to modify /output and reported temp-file-only verification.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote and edited the project files directly in /output and listed the final output tree before closure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No shared-state merge problem is visible: parallel write ownership was concentrated in the implementation child and the verifier swarm was read-only with respect to the deliverable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel combined child-local build/diff/fuzz checks with four independent verifier returns and then passed the official evaluator.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed local example, curated, fuzz, random-combo, and build checks and then passed the official evaluator.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel verification was broader in distributed form, but both modes had sufficient end-to-end evidence before closure and both official evaluations passed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used more elapsed agent time and five subagents, but ended normally without timeout and with all verifier children completed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used fewer tool calls and no subagents, also ended normally without timeout after completing local verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel workflow was heavier but did not exhaust budget, strand work, or shorten closure in a way that affected correctness.

outcome_analysis.explanation: There is no official outcome discordance: the current completed status evaluation for each mode reports solution_passed true with 40 of 40 testcases passing. The parallel path differs by delegating implementation and read-only verification, while the serial path performs the same work in one agent; both converge on the required black-box behavior and deliver an accepted Cargo project.
parallel_contributors: Parent probing established the task surface, the implementation child corrected the real singularize/classify behavior, and the verifier swarm returned zero-mismatch reports before final closure.
serial_contributors: The main agent kept all behavioral discoveries, code edits, rebuilds, and fuzz checks in one context and corrected its early uncountable-list miss before final closure.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel organized the implementation around inflection/plural.rs and a library target, while serial used inflection/singular.rs and an Inflector facade; both structures satisfied the evaluator.
Both runs initially made imperfect inferences about inflection rules and corrected them through black-box differential testing.

cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 13 Level-2 rows and all 32 Level-3 candidates were audited; no candidate met the retention gate because no parallel coordination boundary caused lost work, omitted required stages, uninspected results, collision, contamination, shortened verification, or an unverifiable final state.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: No labels were retained merely for child count, elapsed time, sequential probing, or harmless temporary tooling failures because those facts did not produce a realized parallel-side adverse consequence.
